# Working in this repo

A Markdown and HTML mirror of the LTA DataMall API User Guide PDF, plus the
scripts that produce and verify it. GitHub Pages serves the repo root from
`main`; `.nojekyll` turns off Jekyll, so there is no build step.

## Generated files

`LTA_DataMall_API_User_Guide.md`, `index.html` and `images/` are generated by
`scripts/convert.py`. Do not edit them by hand. Fix the converter and
regenerate. The page's CSS and JS live in `convert.py` too.

Both outputs are rendered from the same parsed blocks. Change the parser
once; change a renderer only for output-specific markup.

## Commands

```sh
pip install -r requirements.txt
python scripts/convert.py --pdf-out guide.pdf   # download + convert
python scripts/convert.py --pdf guide.pdf       # convert a local PDF
python scripts/check.py --pdf guide.pdf         # verify both outputs against the PDF
```

The check takes about a minute. In `index.html`, elements marked
`data-chrome` (site header, contents, footer) are not page content and the
check skips them. Put anything not from the PDF inside one.

## Rules

- Run `scripts/check.py` after any change to `convert.py`. All checks must
  pass before committing.
- Keep `check.py` independent of `convert.py`. It must read the PDF itself;
  do not import from the converter, or a converter bug will pass its own
  check.
- Do not loosen a check to make output pass. Fix the converter, or, if the
  check is wrong, fix it and confirm it still fails on a broken copy of the
  output (drop a table row, unbold a word, delete an image reference,
  remove a `colspan`).
- No hard-coded document text in the converter. Rules must work from
  layout and fonts so they survive new PDF versions.
- Pin dependency versions in `requirements.txt`. After a bump, regenerate
  and run the checks.
- `guide.pdf` is a build artifact. Do not commit it.
